title: Run Her
desc:
all Run and PSL??? 🍂☕️🤎🏃🏽‍♀️

Join us on September 27th at 10 am @wet_coffee_community for RUN’HER FALL EDIT - a fall women’s community run and coffee social pop-up 🤎

Your experience:
• A beginner-friendly scenic fall run through Downtown Oakville 🏃🏽‍♀️🍂
• A post-run coffee social featuring @wet_coffee_community new FALL drink menu 🍁☕️
• Post-run wellness goodies 🤎

All levels are welcome - bring your running shoes, your water bottle, and a friend (or come solo and meet new ones 🤎)!

Tickets will be live via the link in our bio on September 13th at 6:00 pm EST - spots are limited 🏃🏽‍♀️🍂
